subject: Community Preservation Act Appropriations and ARPA Presentation
overview: The Council approved eleven Community Preservation Act funding requests for local landmarks and parks and received an update on the city's $48 million ARPA spending strategy.

items.title: Senior Tax Deferral Income Limit
items.summary: Approved a resolution to tie the local income limit for senior tax deferral to the state's senior circuit breaker amount in perpetuity.

items.title: Ceremonial Resolutions and Business Licenses
items.summary: Approved common victualler licenses for Fudge Town and Crumble Cookies and passed several resolutions honoring local citizens and offering condolences.

items.title: City Messenger Reappointment and Technician Compensation
items.summary: Reappointed Lawrence Leopore as City Messenger and approved a request for the administration to discuss a salary increase for the city's video technician.

items.title: Energy Assistance and Municipal Aggregation Report
items.summary: Approved a request for the administration to provide residents with information on heating assistance programs and a report comparing the cost of the municipal aggregate electric contract to National Grid.

items.title: ARPA Spending Presentation
items.summary: Federal Funds Manager Molly Kivi presented the city’s $48 million ARPA strategy, detailing eligibility rules, revenue replacement calculations, and the community engagement timeline.

items.title: Committee of the Whole Reports
items.summary: Approved reports regarding the Charter Review Commission and the Community Preservation Committee project recommendations.

items.title: Community Preservation Act Appropriations
items.summary: Approved eleven Community Preservation Act appropriations totaling over $1.4 million for projects including the Brooks Estate, Oak Grove Cemetery, Wright's Pond, and multiple park renovations.
